name: Host Resources
description: Parser untuk membaca kapasitas RAM, Disk, dan CPU via SNMP

name: PM5560 Modbus TCP
description: Parser untuk Schneider PowerLogic PM5560 — Voltage, Current, Power, PF, Hz, KWh via Modbus FC03

name: ILS GlidePath Thales 421
description: Parser biner PKT_C 92-byte untuk GP Thales 421 via Moxa NPort TCP. Sync 0x118D[b2]0C, float32 LE, DDM×100.

name: ILS Localizer Thales 421
description: Parser biner PKT_C 92-byte untuk LLZ Thales 421 via Moxa NPort TCP. Sync 0x118D[b2]0C, float32 LE, DDM×100.

name: VHF MARC RSE (TCP/SLIP)
description: Parser binary MARC/RSE protocol via Moxa NPort TCP port 950. SLIP framing, CRC-16/CCITT. Polling aktif T6 command ke radio T6T/T6R. Satu koneksi TCP shared antar equipment.

name: Temp/Humidity Sensor (Modbus TCP)
description: Parser sensor suhu & kelembaban via Modbus TCP FC03 port 502. Register 0=temp×10, 1=humidity×10. Threshold WARN≥30°C, ALARM≥35°C.

name: ASTERIX CAT034 Radar MSSR
description: Parser ASTERIX CAT034 untuk Radar MSSR via UDP Multicast. Status connectivity, SAC/SIC, last update per radar site.

name: ASTERIX CAT021 ADS-B
description: Parser ASTERIX CAT021 untuk ADS-B via UDP Multicast 239.71.40.2:50000. Identifikasi station by SAC/SIC.

name: System Monitor (Server/Workstation/Switch)
description: SNMP v2c HOST-RESOURCES-MIB. CPU, RAM, Disk usage via snmpwalk. Threshold Warning>=80%, Alarm>=95%.

name: Network Device Monitor
description: SNMP v2c basic network parser. System info, uptime, location, and interface count for switches/routers/network devices.

name: ILS GP Normarc
description: ILS Glide Path (GP) Parser untuk Normarc via HDLC/Binary.

name: ILS Localizer Normarc 7000
description: Parser untuk LLZ Normarc 7000 via Moxa NPort TCP
